about_the_game:
Jack awakens in endless darkness and pain, enduring the insane torment of the zombie virus in an illegal laboratory. I thought I would end up in this dark place, but I discovered that my body had undergone a strange transformation and survived in a non-human form. ​

He defeated the demons in the laboratory one by one with his powerful power after the mutation. The person who once subjected him to cruel experiments is now trembling in front of him, begging for mercy. But Jack only has the flame of revenge in his heart, and he will not spare anyone who participates in this evil experiment. ​

As revenge advanced, he gradually discovered that there was a bigger conspiracy hidden behind this illegal laboratory. He decided to continue the investigation and expose all the sins in the sunlight. In order to prevent more innocent compatriots from being harmed, he also wanted to seek justice for himself and for those who died innocently.

CHARACTERISTIC

  • Two game modes allow you to experience different gaming sensations in battles and strategies.

  • Multiple professions of roles to choose from, spanning multiple dimensions from veterans to tailors, from engineers to grave keepers, and more

  • Rich props and weapons for you to choose from!

  • You can choose from a variety of combat modes if you are equipped with both ranged and melee weapons!

short_description: The Awakened Avenger is a top-down shooting light ROGUE game where players take on the role of a zombie who has been damaged by a biochemical experiment but retains self-awareness. Survive and defeat the ultimate villain by selecting different equipment and props.
